Initially many candidates indicated the required angle as angle CEB rather than angle CEA. Therefore a lot
of work was done on triangle CEB. Some candidates were not convinced that triangle AEC was right-angled
and they also struggled to use Pythagoras’ Theorem to find EA first because they did not recognise angle
EBA as a right-angle or they did not join EA in the first place. Once sides were found the trigonometry
proved less demanding.
